answer: Because the dune calculation reruns each epoch, the zenith weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the whisper settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 21% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 140 clones as a result holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 16 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
